parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL5390237. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by chembl_id CHEMBL5390237. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return one row per molecule with columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
